id.description: Must equal the folder path under pages/, e.g. 'network/topology'.

kind.description: Page kind. Recommended: vision, overview, service, flow, network, infra, data, integration, proposal, decision, roadmap, runbook, reference, glossary.

entry.description: Source file when the page has no variants. Defaults to index.md, then index.html.

variants.description: Milestone id -> source file. A page with variants renders a different body per milestone.

standalone.description: For .html sources: true = a complete HTML document shown in an iframe; false (default) = an HTML fragment placed inside the book layout.

sources.description: Where the facts on this page come from (docs, repos, people).
